description: Ouvrages de protection des rives is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Kanton Genf. Cette couche recense les ouvrages de protection des rives et des berges le long des cours d'eau, tels que murs, gabions, digues, etc. Aux informations générales de génie civil s'ajoute une évaluation de l'impact écologique de l'ouvrage sur l'environnement. En général une photo illustre l'ouvrage. Coverage: Kanton Genf. The portal files it under the publisher Kanton Genf. It offers 9 resource(s) in API, CSV, GML, KML, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
